title: NASA-UAP-D4, Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing, 1969
doc_notes: This document is the declassified Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing from 1969, containing reports of visual sightings and cabin phenomena.

incidents.summary: Apollo 11 crew observed an unidentified object while traveling to the Moon.
incidents.explanation: Crew speculated it could be the S-IVB stage, a panel, or part of the high gain antenna.
incidents.quote: The first unusual thing that we saw I guess was 1 day out or something pretty close to the moon.

incidents.summary: Astronaut Buzz Aldrin observed flashes of light inside the cabin while trying to sleep.
incidents.explanation: Crew speculated they were neutrons or atomic particles causing emissions upon entering the cabin.
incidents.quote: I observed what I thought were little flashes inside the cabin, spaced a couple of minutes apart

incidents.summary: Crew observed a bright light source while in lunar orbit.
incidents.explanation: Initially thought to be a laser, later concluded to be a reflection of the Sun off a lake on Earth.
incidents.quote: I observed what appeared to be a fairly bright light source which we tentatively ascribed to a possible laser.
